statement: The T029 candidate **shall** satisfy the deterministic Fabro gate for a test task: the six named work products exist, at least one `tests/` path changes, `cmake` configure, build, discovery, and the full `ctest` suite pass, and `git diff --check` is clean; the T029 checkbox is marked complete **only** in the implementation stage, and the inherited `engineering/trace/links.json` and `engineering/stage-results/*.json` provenance digests are refreshed when the shared `src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt` digest changes.
title: T029 requirement 025
